title: anthriscus vulgaris var. hispanica
intro: Anthriscus vulgaris var. hispanica, commonly known as garden cress, is a cool-season annual plant belonging to the parsley family. It is rich in vitamins A, C, and K, and has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of garden cress include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and infection. The bioactive constituents of garden cress include glucosinolates, such as glucoraphanin and glucosativin, which are responsible for its potential therapeutic effects.
